title: Lemon and Herb Quinoa Pilaf
summary: Toasted quinoa simmered with soft onion, then fluffed with parsley, chives, mint and lemon.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Toast
steps.text: Stir the quinoa in the dry saucepan over medium heat 5-6 min until it crackles and smells nutty, then tip into a bowl.

steps.title: Soften
steps.text: Melt the butter in the pan and cook the onion with the salt 5 min until soft and pale gold.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the water and quinoa, bring to the boil, then cover and cook on the lowest heat 18 min, stirring once halfway.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Take off the heat and leave covered 10 min.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Fluff with a fork and fold in the herbs, lemon zest and juice; serve with lemon wedges.

tips: Rinse the quinoa well to remove any bitter coating.
Do not lift the lid while it simmers.
Good warm or at room temperature.
storage: Cool quickly and keep covered in the fridge for up to 3 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
